product_metadata.title: GreenPan Lima Hard Anodized Healthy Ceramic Nonstick 8QT Stock Pot with Lid, PFAS-Free, Oven Safe, Gray
features: Our Thermolon healthy ceramic nonstick heats evenly and cleans up easily every time
Manufactured without the use of PFAS, PFOA, lead, or cadmium so it won’t release toxic fumes, even when overheated
A hard anodized construction delivers both strength and scratch resistance
Tempered glass lids (oven safe up to 425°F) let you keep an eye on things without losing steam
Oven safe stainless steel handles are curved for easy gripping
Oven and broiler safe up to 600°F
description: Crafted from tough, scratch-resistant hard anodized aluminum, the Lima Collection features the classics. Our signature healthy ceramic coating is as nonstick as they come (for easy food release and cleanup), all without PFAS, PFOA, lead, or cadmium. Perfect for big braises, seafood boils, and delicious stocks, this 8-quart stockpot and lid gives you plenty of room for everything.

details.Material: Ceramic, PFAS Free Nonstick, Hard Anodized Aluminum, Stainless Steel Handles
